Welcome to

Aanjaneya Aerodynamics Pvt.Ltd.

Aerospace & Defence Technology Solution Provider

The Indian aerospace and defence industry is one of the fastest-growing aerospace markets in the world with an expanding consumer base comprising defence, airlines, businesses and High Net worth Individuals. The rapid growth of this industry has attracted major global aerospace and defence companies to India. All segments in the aerospace industry, including civil and military aviation and space, are showing a significant level of growth. Presently, in India the aerospace and defence sector has a huge potential with the country ranked as the 10th largest investor globally. The industry is currently undergoing a transition with increased participation from the private sector. The government is taking significant initiatives to develop India as a competent aerospace and defence equipment manufacturing base. India is an attractive low cost manufacturing and engineering service base, offering significant opportunities to both domestic and international players. We believe the air platforms segment to be the most attractive segment in the country over the next decade.
The Government of India’s policy on offsets is expected to lead to the integration of overseas suppliers that directly supply equipment to the Indian government with the local manufacturing sector. Foreign aerospace manufacturers looking at entering India and Indian companies can become offset partners and capitalize on the growth opportunity in this segment.

Encouraged by the steady technological growth and development of the aerospace & defence sector in India, we have decided to venture in to the challenging Aerospace & Defence sector. We have the technical abilities to absorb and enhance the latest technology in the field. In our opinion any partnership by us with a foreign aerospace & defence company to form Joint Ventures would be largely beneficial to all the stake holders.
